prompts.text: Share your rose (a win), thorn (a struggle), and bud (something you look forward to).
Your rose: something that went well this week. One line.
Your thorn: something that didn't go as planned. One line.
Your bud: something you're excited about. One line.
Rose, thorn, bud — but keep all three in one sentence.
Rose: a small victory from today.
Thorn: the thing that's quietly annoying you.
Bud: the next thing on your calendar you're looking forward to.
Rose, thorn, bud — team edition: one win, one issue, one hope for the team.
Rose: a moment that made you smile this week.
Thorn: a blocker you're wrestling with.
Bud: a possibility you're curious about.
